name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Experimental hidden trajectory prediction: delays cube, robot, and wave inputs predicted to die, and replays only after a safe result.

enabled.name: Enable Predictive Buffer
enabled.description: Turn predictive input delaying on or off without restarting. Turning it off immediately replays any queued press.

prediction-frames.name: Trajectory Lookahead (frames)
prediction-frames.description: How many game updates the hidden player simulates while holding the control input to test whether the path dies. Larger values may cost more time per click.
